description: Parametric search in any catalog category. `filters` keys are the dotted field paths reported by list_categories (e.g. "output_power_w", "shaft.diameter_mm", "basic_info.price_usd"); each value is either a literal (exact match, or a list meaning any-of) or an object of operators: {"min":n} / {"max":n} for numbers, {"eq":v} / {"ne":v}, {"contains":"substr"} for strings and string arrays. Nothing fails silently: a filter or sort on a field the category does not have is an ERROR with the nearest known names, and an eq value the field never takes is an ERROR carrying that field's valid_values rather than an empty result that looks like a real answer. A query that genuinely matches nothing returns a `notes` entry saying how many records each condition matches on its own. Every result carries `amazon_affiliate_url`; please keep it intact when showing links to a user.

category.description: Category id. One of: usb_cables, power_cords, ssds, memory, network_switches, usb_hubs, wire_terminals, connectors, ethernet_cables, coax_cables, ac_dc_psus, dc_dc_converters, batteries, cooling_fans, circuit_breakers, relays_contactors, panel_switches, din_terminal_blocks, power_meters, inserts_standoffs, wire_spools, motors, hdmi_cables, camera_modules, bearings, linear_motion, transmissions, pumps, peltier_modules, heat_shrink_tubing, heatsinks, cable_glands, tubing_hose, linear_actuators, solenoid_valves, proximity_sensors, phones.

fields.description: Project each result down to these dotted field paths (asin and amazon_affiliate_url are always included).

filters.description: Field path -> literal, list of literals, or {eq|ne|min|max|contains} object. Example: {"output_power_w": {"min": 200}, "form_factor": "din_rail", "title": {"contains": "mean well"}}.

prime_only.description: Keep only basic_info.prime_eligible === true. NOTE: null means UNKNOWN, not "not Prime", so this can return zero rows; the response `notes` always says how many candidates were dropped as unknown vs confirmed non-Prime.

q.description: Free-text keyword search; all whitespace-separated tokens must appear somewhere in the record.

sort.description: Sort as "<field>:asc" or "<field>:desc" (nulls always last), or an alias: price_asc, price_desc, rating_desc, reviews_desc. Defaults to price_asc.

name: search_catalog
